scales.clock_time: text-[8rem] lg:text-[10rem] font-light tracking-tighter leading-none font-serif
scales.date: text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-light tracking-widest uppercase text-white/80 font-sans
scales.hotel_name: text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-semibold tracking-widest uppercase font-serif
scales.weather_cond: text-xl font-light uppercase tracking-widest text-white/70 font-sans
scales.news_headline: text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-light leading-relaxed max-w-4xl font-serif italic text-white/90

display_screen.structure: Grid-based or Flex layout over absolute background. Push elements to the far corners. High negative space.
display_screen.alignment: Left: Hotel Name (Top) & Weather (Bottom). Right: Clock/Date (Top) & News (Bottom). Use optical alignment.

admin_panel.style: Dark mode forced. Cardless or 1px border cards. Minimalist technical aesthetic.

background_slider.description: Absolute inset-0. Renders images. Uses Framer Motion for slow, elegant 2-second crossfade (opacity 0 to 1). Includes the gradient overlay overlaying it.

clock_widget.description: Live digital clock top right. Massive size. No seconds shown, just HH:MM to maintain elegance. AM/PM subtle.

weather_widget.description: Bottom left. Large, minimal line icons (Lucide). Temp on left, vertical stack of condition/high-low on right.

news_ticker.description: Bottom right. Displays exactly ONE headline at a time. Transitions via Framer Motion AnimatePresence (fade in and slide up slightly). Refreshes every 30 mins, rotates headline every 15s locally.
news_ticker.classes: max-w-2xl text-right flex flex-col items-end gap-4

admin_form.description: Shadcn based. Dark theme. Clean input fields, subtle hover states. No heavy box-shadows.

motion.news_transition: initial: { opacity: 0, y: 10 }, animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 }, exit: { opacity: 0, y: -10 }, transition: { duration: 1 }

image_urls.description: Checkered floor living room with large windows

accessibility.contrast: Ensure the gradient overlay is dark enough (black/80 at text locations) to pass APCA contrast checks.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a React app using Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and lucide-react.
Install fonts: import Playfair Display and Outfit in index.css.
Create two main views: A public display ('/') and an Admin Panel ('/admin').

The public display ('/') MUST be built using raw HTML/Tailwind/Framer Motion. Do NOT use Shadcn components for the display screen to maintain complete creative layout control. It must be `h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden`.
Ensure the rotating background images stretch to cover the screen (`object-cover`) and use a heavy dark gradient overlay so text is extremely legible from a distance.
The Clock and Date should use `setInterval` to update live.
Integrate OpenWeatherMap and NewsAPI.org. Create robust fallback mock data if the API keys are not provided or fail (e.g. mock weather to 72°F Sunny, mock news to a generic positive headline).
Rotate hotel photos every 8-10 seconds via Framer Motion crossfade.

The Admin panel ('/admin') MUST use Shadcn components. Force dark mode on it for a premium backend feel. Store preferences (City, Hotel Name) in `localStorage` or a mock backend state to reflect on the display view.
Apply `data-testid` to all major interactive and informational nodes.
Do not add horizontal scrolling. Use clean, extreme padding (p-16 or p-24) to keep content far from screen edges (TV safe zones).
